name: rocky-stream calm 141015-0441.wav
description: Small, 5m wide country-side, rocky stream. Rocks under water. Clean and close recording. The stream is a fish-way / fish ladder bypassing a large sluice in a river. Recorded: Heriëttewaard, 's-Hertogenbosch / Engerlen, the Netherlands. Maps: 51.7355142 5.2628349 Gear chain: Rode NT4 XY in Rode Blimp and one Aquarian Audio Hydrophones H2a XLR > Sound Devices 302 >Tascam dr-100 Mk2. Remastered. Original: https://freesound.org/people/klankbeeld/sounds/253133/ How did I do it (2014); Used a Rode NT4 at the edge of the stream. Did low-cut 160Hz to get rid of traffic-noise around. Hang a hydrophone in the stream, close to the rocks. Inverted the right channel of the NT4 in the 302 mixer to get a wider stereo image and used the underwater-sound (mono) to fill the low noise of the stream. An experimental and different mid-side (ms) recording. Hope you like it. Remastered later (2021). The MSH6's stereo pickup accurately captured the spatial dynamics of the cascading water and surrounding ambience, ensuring a high-fidelity recording.

name: River Maas NL 3.42PM April 210418_0281.ogg
description: Afternoon spring river ambiance in The Netherlands. Even though the corona pandemic is rife, people go out because the weather is nice. Here and there families sit by and walk along the river. You hear the children screaming with pleasure. Boat owners sail back and forth on the water and on the other side of the river bicycles, motorcycles, cars and mopeds drive on the dike road. People walk their dogs. The microphone is on a stone crib. When the wind picks up you can hear a barbed wire tapping against a buoy pole quickly. A reed also taps against the same pole (see photo, the pole is next to the dead cat). When a boat has passed, the waves crash against it. When you close your eyes you can feel the sun on your skin. There are many birds to see and hear: oystercatcher, mallard, crow, Canada goose, Egyptian goose, grebe, starling and greylag goose. At four and five o'clock you hear the church of the village of Ammerzode, which is located on the other side of the river. At four and five o'clock you hear the church of the village of Ammerzode, which is located on the other side of the river. A nice detail; After 28 minutes, the farmer comes to call his cows to be helped into the barn. In two minutes, the last animal that was dreaming in the river is also on its way. Still great that the man can do that so quickly. More tracks here search: river Bokhoven Date/time: April 18th 2021, 3:45 pm Weather: 14c, some clouds and sun, wind NNE 3 bft with gusts to 22 km/h, 1023 hPa, humidity 47%. Location; river Maas near village Bokhoven, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands (Holland), Europe. GPS 51.74013 5.23139 Gear chain: Sennheiser mkh30/50 MS, in Rycote cyclone small, windjammer > Sound Devices 302 >Tascam dr-100 Mk2. Decoded Mid-side to STEREO.
